en.quote: In 2024, we plan to launch production of 20 import-substituted [SSJ100] aircraft a year, with domestically made PD-8 engines.
en.head: In April 2025, the industry minister said first SJ-100 deliveries with PD-8 engines were scheduled for early 2026.
en.body: Interfax reported that the start of deliveries had been “repeatedly postponed”; serial production of the SSJ100 with foreign components stopped in 2022. Whether aircraft had been delivered by autumn 2026 has not been checked for this entry.

notes: Preserve the difference between SSJ100 and SJ-100 model naming as used in each source.
